import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep, colored by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', palette='Set2', s=100)

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Add legend with a title
plt.legend(title='BMI Category & Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc=2, borderaxespad=0.)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
